title: Simulation 3D Joystick
text: 处理来自异步操纵杆设备的输入，输入 1 路、输出 3 路；{Joystick ID} 指定分配给给定操纵杆设备的 ID、{Adjust I/O ports according to joystick capabilities} 用于动态调整端口以对应于操纵杆能力、{Enable force-feedback input} 用于支持带力反馈的操纵杆，按实例取值。

ports.name: Axes
ports.summary: 沿任意给定轴的操纵杆位置 vector with each element in the range [-1,1]

ports.name: Buttons
ports.summary: 操纵杆按钮的状态 vector of 0 and 1

ports.name: Point of view
ports.summary: 操纵杆视角选择器的当前状态 -1 (selector inactive) | scalar

params.name: Joystick ID
params.values: 分配给给定操纵杆设备的 ID 1 (default)

params.name: Adjust I/O ports according to joystick capabilities
params.values: 用于动态调整端口以对应于操纵杆能力的选项 on (default) | off

params.name: Enable force-feedback input
params.values: 用于支持带力反馈的操纵杆的选项 on (default) | off
